question.question: Which New task form organization fits this right-hand panel best?

content.text: I recommend B: quiet sections make the form easier to scan without adding navigation or hiding settings. The tradeoff is a little more vertical space than the current form. All six views use the actual 368 × 964 panel size.

Your header/footer changes and real model dropdown are fixed requirements, not choices. A is the actual current capture for comparison; B–F show those changes. Folder Choose… already opens the system folder picker. “Pi default” preserves the current blank model setting; the implemented dropdown will search real configured Pi models, not a hardcoded list. This question decides only how the form is organized.
Keep the existing flat field order. Least structural change, but related fields have little separation. Your fixed header/footer and model changes still apply.

content.alt: Actual current native New scheduled task panel, with flat field stack

content.text: Task, Location, Schedule, and Runner sections with subtle dividers. Easy to scan while keeping every setting visible.

content.text: Labels sit beside controls for a dense settings-style form. Shorter scan, but less room for long folders and prompts.

content.text: Separate cards can collapse after setup; shown fully expanded here. Strong boundaries, with extra borders and interaction.

content.alt: New task form in four expanded collapsible cards

content.text: Run, In, Every, Using groups read like a task recipe. More conversational, but less like the surrounding settings UI.
